audit_items.proof_trace: The property `tokenAmount == acceptedCapital / tokenPrice` is enforced entirely by the off-chain Merkle computation: `claimTokenAllocation` accepts an `amount` parameter verified only against `claimTokensMerkleRoot`, with no on-chain formula linking it to `acceptedCapital` or `tokenPrice`. The two Merkle roots (`claimTokensMerkleRoot`, `acceptedCapitalMerkleRoot`) are independent inputs to `publishSaleResults`, published by the trusted Legion admin. This is the system's intended trust model — off-chain allocation with cryptographic Merkle commitment.
